narrative:
Short impact summary

Flavins and Flavoproteins (1984), published by De Gruyter, has been cited 686 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 1% of works in its field and year. Beyond that, it has been downloaded 279 times.

Full narrative

Flavins and Flavoproteins by R. C. Bray, P. C. Engel and S. G. Mayhew was published by De Gruyter in 1984. Conceptually, the work connects to Flavoprotein, Flavin group, Computer science, Biology and Biochemistry.

OpenAlex records 686 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2004 with 41 citing works. Notable citing venues include Journal of Biological Chemistry, Biochemistry and Biochemical Journal. The citing works include 579 journal articles, 70 book chapters, 12 reviews and 9 dissertations. They come from 40 countries, led by the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom.

It has been downloaded 279 times via Ubiquity Press. Open Library reports a combined count of 1 reading logs and catalog editions. Its subject matter aligns with Zero hunger among the Sustainable Development Goals.
